methods.what: Invariant-type expression 9c^2-12bd+3ae computed for a ternary quartic regarded as a quartic in x
Condition for a quartic a_4x^4+4a_3x^3+6a_2x^2+4a_1x+a_0 to be the square of a quadratic
Fourth power of a linear form transformed via cross-product coordinates (2x2 minors), with coefficients written as products of index-triples
Factorisation of a quartic into two quadratics by comparing coefficients, leading to a resolvent cubic in sigma
Expression in terms of the quartic invariants (resolvent written with 3c^2-4bd+ae and the catalecticant-type invariant)
